release_notes: Flex Phone 1.0.6.89 separates portal passwords from SIP registration credentials, improves extension authorization messaging, and keeps approved SIP route fallback behavior.
release_notes_list: Portal sign-in now treats the typed password as portal-only.
SIP registration now uses only the phone-registration secret returned by Flex PBX after portal authentication.
Flex Phone no longer falls back to the typed portal password for SIP REGISTER.
If Flex PBX signs in but does not return phone-registration credentials, Flex Phone now shows a clear support message.
A SIP 401 now explains that the portal password and phone-registration secret are different.
Extension authorization instructions remain in a readable, read-only box before email confirmation.
Approved public and secure Headscale SIP routes remain available for registration retry.
